title: Ledger Stax from CryptoBilis, shared by @wentrre

purchase.dateNote: From the order confirmation the buyer posted: a Ledger Stax in Graphite, paid with "Bilis Pay", priced in Malaysian ringgit. The store's name isn't visible in the screenshot. CryptoBilis is inferred from the payment method and currency.

components: Nordic Semiconductor nRF9151 LACA A1 LTE-M / NB-IoT module, lot 2539XAAC000KXDC (likely week 39 of 2025)
QFN chip next to the module, with no readable markings
Printed antenna on the inside of the back cover, marked AC-A2014-STAX-V1.1, with a coax lead to a u.FL connector
An extra layer on the circuit board, which the buyer noticed first
implant.notes: Wentrre (@wentrre) asked why the circuit board of his Ledger Stax had an extra layer. The photos show a Nordic nRF9151 cellular module, which a genuine Stax doesn't have, and a printed antenna inside the back cover. Two days later he posted the parts on a scale (49.0 g in total) and said he bought it in April. The order confirmation is dated 27 April 2026. The antenna follows the same AC-A2xxx naming as the Flex (AC-A2201-FLEX) and Nano X (AC-A2016-NANO, AC-A2205-NANO-X) antennas in other reports. The nRF9151's lot code starts 2539, the same week as Specimen B's (2539XAAG00ETTE5). The Data Matrix code on the module decodes to that lot code, not to an IMEI.
